education.institution: CENTURION UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY AND MANAGEMENT

education.description: I completed my Higher Secondary education at Hijli High School, Kharagpur, a co-educational institution established in 1951 under the Department of Education, West Bengal. The school offers classes from VI to XII and is known for its commitment to academic excellence. During my time there, I focused on PCM+CS, achieving 1st Division. Being one of Top 7 Students in the Batch. The school provided a supportive environment with access to a library housing over 2,000 books and functional computer facilities, which enhanced my learning experience. The curriculum and faculty at Hijli High School played a significant role in preparing me for higher education, fostering a strong foundation in Time Management, Critical Thinking, Team Management, Public Speaking and Extensive R&D Opportunities in Computer Sciences.

I completed my schooling from Class I to Class X at Splendour High School, Salua, Kharagpur, a co-educational institution established in 1987 and affiliated with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (ICSE Board). In my ICSE examinations, I secured a score of 78%, placing me among the top 10 students in my batch. Beyond academics, I actively participated in various extracurricular activities that enriched my educational journey: Morning Assembly Illustrations: Assigned to create visual illustrations, enhancing the assembly experience. Science Exhibition Organizer: Took the initiative to organize and manage the school's science exhibition, fostering scientific curiosity among peers. Computer Lab Operator: Assisted in managing the computer lab, ensuring smooth operation and aiding fellow students. Sports Day Participant: Actively participated in various events during the school's annual sports day, promoting teamwork and physical fitness.
